version.description: Version of Kiro CLI to install. Use 'latest' for the newest available, or a full version like '2.3.0'.

disableAutoupdates.description: Disable automatic background updates for Kiro CLI.

defaultModel.description: Default chat model (chat.defaultModel), e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4.6'. Empty means the setting is not touched.

agentEngine.description: Agent engine (chat.agentEngine): 'v1', 'v2' or 'v3'. Empty means the setting is not touched.

disableGreeting.description: Disable the Kiro CLI greeting (chat.greeting.enabled=false). When false, the setting is not touched.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of agent skill sources to install globally for Kiro CLI via the skills CLI (npx skills add). Each entry accepts owner/repo shorthand (e.g. vercel-labs/agent-skills) or a full GitHub URL. Node.js is installed on demand. Skipped when empty.
